title: WellFair Knowledge Extraction Schema
description: Output schema for the LLM paper-parser. One document per source study or legislative text.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Always '1.0' for this version.

doi_or_url.description: DOI (preferred) or canonical URL of the source document.

title.description: Full title of the paper or legislative document.

authors.description: Author list in 'Surname, Initials' format. May be empty for legislation.

journal_or_source.description: Journal name, government body, or publishing organisation.

domain.description: Broad domain of the source document.

resolution_notes.description: Free-text notes about any unresolved URIs or ambiguities encountered during extraction.

logical_implications.description: Each element represents one directional implication extracted from the source.

implication_id.description: Unique snake_case identifier within this document (e.g. 'dm_nephropathy_1'). Used as Prolog clause comment.

condition_display.description: Human-readable label for the condition (for UI display).

biomarker_triggers.description: Measurable thresholds that must be satisfied for this implication to fire. All triggers are ANDed together. If empty, the implication fires on condition alone.

value.description: Primary threshold value. For 'between', this is the lower bound.

value_upper.description: Upper bound for 'between' operator only. Null for all other operators.

unit.description: UCUM unit string (informational only; not used in Prolog logic).

affected_anatomical_structures.description: FMA anatomical structure URIs implicated by this finding.

fma_uri.description: FMA term. Format: 'fma:<TermName>'. Use 'unresolved' if no FMA term found.

mechanism_summary.description: 1–2 sentences in plain English explaining the biological mechanism. Shown to users in the Explainer sidebar.

is_hierarchy_target.description: Set true if this FMA URI is a parent class requiring hierarchy traversal (e.g. fma:Joint_structure for EDS). The SPARQL resolver will use rdfs:subClassOf* traversal instead of exact match.

affected_entitlements.description: For welfare/legal documents only. Entitlements or services triggered by this implication.

entitlement_uri.description: URI for the entitlement. Format: 'welfare:<term>' or a legislative reference URI.

eligibility_notes.description: Additional eligibility conditions not captured by biomarker_triggers.

comorbidity_modifiers.description: Optional. Additional conditions that, if present alongside condition_indicated, escalate severity.

condition_uri.description: SNOMED or welfare URI of the co-occurring condition.

escalates_to.description: Severity escalation when this comorbidity is present.

affected_uris.description: Specific FMA URIs whose severity escalates. If empty, all URIs in this implication are affected.

citation_fragment.description: Optional direct quote or paraphrase from the source that supports this implication. For expert review verification.
